vaults.name: Momentum bot
vaults.blurb: Rule-based: long NEAR when the 1h EMA is above the 6h EMA, flat when below.

vaults.name: Mean-reversion bot
vaults.blurb: Rule-based: buys NEAR 1.5σ below its 6h mean, sells 1.5σ above.

vaults.name: AI leader
vaults.blurb: An LLM on NEAR AI Cloud decides each epoch from public market data; it commits to its rationale by hash only.

vaults.blurb: A human leader signing signals by hand.
